name: Vanilla Fudge I
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Line a deep tray with grease-proof paper.
Combine the white sugar, syrup, condensed milk and butter together in a saucepan.
Cook on a medium level of heat on the stove and bring to boil. Stirring constantly (so it doesn’t burn), cook for 5 minutes after it reaches boiling point.
Remove the fudge from the heat and beat in the vanilla extract.
Pour the fudge into the tray and leave to cool until set.
